claim_1_halfspace.mechanism: literal edge bisection/rational recovery and independent simplex evaluation
claim_1_halfspace.scope: all grid lotteries for five source-model quantized halfspaces.

claim_2_deterministic.mechanism: learn/restart/Select loop with independent finite LP-grid solver
claim_2_deterministic.scope: complete source membership-query loop on feasible and infeasible instances.

claim_3_randomized.mechanism: source multiset sampling without replacement, cached hyperplanes, full verification, and violator doubling
claim_3_randomized.scope: complete finite Algorithm-3 loop on an 80-agent, 3-alternative source-model instance.

claim_4_lower_bound.mechanism: complete positive epsilon-grid singleton-feasibility construction and leaf count
claim_4_lower_bound.scope: source lower-bound construction at n=6, m=3, epsilon=0.1.

claim_5_prediction.mechanism: Algorithm 2 with predicted agent order and record-agent/query accounting
claim_5_prediction.scope: finite predicted-order instance with two binding and three dummy agents.

limitations: Finite executions validate the exact source constructions and controls; the public proof supplies the universal asymptotic quantifiers.
